purpose: One JSON object per REAL collected document (JSONL). Holds only opaque identifiers and review state - never names, account/policy/loan numbers, PAN, Aadhaar, addresses, phone numbers, e-mail or any other personal data. The original document lives only in the offline vault and is referenced by an opaque vault id kept outside this repository's manifests.
three_independent_axes: doc_type, expense_category and tax_evidence are set separately and never derived from one another by the validator; tax_evidence is a derived CANDIDATE list and eligibility is never asserted.

fields.doc_id: stable opaque id, pattern COL-<8 lowercase hex>-<4 lowercase hex> (random at intake; never derived from content, names or file names)
fields.doc_type: one of config/doc_type_schema_v2_1.json document types (cheque, bank_statement, form_16, salary_slip, rent_receipt, ...)
fields.expense_category: Task A category (16 classes) or null when the document is not an expense document
fields.tax_evidence: list from {hra_evidence, section_80c_evidence, section_80d_evidence, loan_interest_evidence, ev_benefit_evidence, meal_benefit_evidence, income_evidence}; may be empty
fields.real: must be true - synthetic documents never enter the collection manifest
fields.source_id: short collection source code, e.g. COLL-ORG-01 (an agreement with a consenting individual or organisation); registered in the consent register kept with the vault, not in this repo
fields.permission_ref: opaque id of the signed consent/permission record held in the vault (e.g. CR-0042); empty string is invalid
fields.issuer_group_id: opaque id IG-<10 hex> = HMAC(offline secret, normalised issuer + template family); every document of one issuer/template family shares it and therefore one split
fields.split: unassigned | train | val | test (assigned deterministically per issuer group; see PROCEDURE)
fields.redacted_copy: relative path in the redacted store (outside the repo or git-ignored) or null until a verified redacted copy exists
fields.ambiguity_flags: list from {type_ambiguous, expense_category_ambiguous, tax_mapping_ambiguous, partial_page, multi_document_pdf, low_quality_scan, language_mixed, specimen_or_template, other_see_notes}
fields.reviewer_notes: short free text without personal data (the validator rejects PAN/Aadhaar/phone/e-mail/account-like strings)
fields.redacted_sha256: optional; sha256 of the verified redacted copy (not personal data) - used to detect duplicates across the collection
fields.redacted_phash: optional; 64-bit perceptual hash of the redacted copy as 16 hex chars - used to flag near-duplicates

gating_rules: split in {train,val,test} requires sensitive_review_status == redacted_verified, a non-null redacted_copy, a permission_basis and permission_ref
split in {val,test} additionally requires annotation_status in {double_annotated, adjudicated}
a document flagged specimen_or_template may be used for training but never for val/test (it is not a real filled document)
all documents of one issuer_group_id share one split; doc_id and redacted_copy are unique
no unknown fields; no personal-data patterns in any string value; eligibility_status never 'eligible'
an unassigned / pending / rejected record is allowed in the manifest but is excluded from every training and evaluation manifest
redacted_sha256 values are unique across the manifest; near-duplicate redacted_phash values (Hamming <= 4) are reported as warnings and, within different issuer groups, as errors only on import
